headline: Ucaneo CEO outlines next steps after opening Germany's largest DAC facility
summary: A gasworld interview with Ucaneo's CEO following the 2 July inauguration of the company's 150 t/yr electrochemical direct-air-capture plant in Berlin-Marzahn — described as Germany's first verified DAC combined with geological storage — flags a roughly ten-times-larger commercial facility with construction targeted from 2027.
co2crc_note: Sub-scale but a rare verified DAC-plus-geological-storage precedent in Europe; relevant to CO2CRC's planned full-chain DAC/BECCS demonstrations at the Otway International Test Centre, though volumes are negligible.
extractor_note: Radar near-miss: the article is in-window (14 Aug) but its news hook — the plant opening — was 2 July 2026, so it is ineligible for the main sections. gasworld page egress-blocked this run; date confirmed from the Google Alerts feed metadata.

headline: Tröegs Independent Brewing secures Pennsylvania carbon-capture grant
summary: Carbon Herald reports that Pennsylvania craft brewer Tröegs won a state grant to capture fermentation CO₂ for on-site reuse — a small-scale industrial capture-and-utilisation example rather than a storage development.
co2crc_note: Peripheral small-scale fermentation-CO₂ capture/utilisation; minimal direct relevance to CO2CRC's geological-storage and MMV focus, but a public-engagement data point on where CCUS grants are flowing.
extractor_note: Radar near-miss (14 Aug, ≤7 days). Grant dollar figure not stated in accessible text; carbonherald page egress-blocked this run, date confirmed from the Google Alerts feed metadata.
